svg.title: Right-handed spin Hall transport geometry across a heavy-metal/ferromagnet bilayer
svg.desc: Isometric 3D heavy-metal/ferromagnet bilayer illustrating Fullmag's right-handed spin Hall convention: conventional charge current J_c and E along +x, transverse spin current Q_za along +z across interface normal n_hat with spin polarization +y, opposite-spin deflection -y downward, interfacial spin accumulation mu_s, and absorbed transverse torque T_tr^G on magnetization m.
